purpose: Teach: 国内外/使い分け/要員/分業/リモート/仕事場/スペック/スクロール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、国内外の研究動向、把握する習慣、つけろ。
lines.en: Ren — build the habit of staying on top of research trends, both domestic and international.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority. Decisive clip on each instruction. Not harsh — a mentor laying out expectations clearly. Slight pause between thoughts, like ticking off a list.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。専門用語、論文と発表で、使い分けるよう、心がけます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be more mindful about how I use technical terminology — one way in papers, another in presentations.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly hurried. Eager to show he's taking notes. Soft on the self-correction, like he's already thinking through where he went wrong before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究の要員、君も、推薦できる人材を、探せ。
lines.en: As for staffing on the joint research — you find people worth recommending too.
lines.style: Same measured authority. The word 'too' carries weight — an expectation of partnership, not just orders. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室内の分業、後輩と、連携して、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with the junior members on dividing up the lab work and keep things moving forward.
lines.style: Respectful, competent. A slight uptick — he's already mentally organizing it as he speaks. Not rushed, but purposeful. Neat and organized in his cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リモート学会、参加機会、増えてきたな、君らも。
lines.en: Remote conferences have become more common for you all these days.
lines.style: Observational, almost musing. A brief pause before 'you all' — noting the shift in the world around them, not commanding. Gentle undercurrent of approval.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の仕事場、整理、徹底しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been thorough about keeping the lab workspace organized.
lines.style: Confident, steady. A slight note of pride — this is something he's already done well. Not defensive, just matter-of-fact. Clean pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新装置のスペック、論文に、しっかり、記載しろ。
lines.en: Make sure the new device specifications are properly documented in the paper.
lines.style: Direct, precise. The word 'properly' lands with quiet emphasis. No room for shortcuts. Clinical but not unkind — this is the standard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文ファイル、無駄にスクロール、しないよう、目次、整備しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've organized the paper file with a table of contents so you don't have to scroll through needlessly.
lines.style: Thoughtful and thorough. Slight satisfaction in having thought ahead — not boasting, just showing the work is done right. Soft landing at the end, like closing a folder.
